product.name: ⚖️ مكتب الأستاذ / أحمد محمد خضير المحامي

dynamicRoutes.page: generic record detail except explicit special cases and witnesses

aliasNotes.meaning: one Quick Notes UI/store, not a second source of truth
static generic list linked from fee detail/report, not a global-nav or direct palette entry

routing.router: PAGES/recordRoute and App.go in js/app.js; RouteHistory in js/core/history-nav.js
routing.urlModel: hash route (#/...) with query state in hash; compatible with static hosting

dynamicRoutes.page: generic record detail except explicit special cases and witnesses

queryParameters.behavior: direct link selects tab; clicking a tab saves a per-file preference and rerenders content without updating URL/history
URL state seeds range/view/query/context/item/review; preferences persist other state
initial filters; table state also persists in preferences

routing.history: RouteHistory owns page-route history and overlay guard entries; Android/browser navigation was tested. Internal file/settings/execution tabs do not call App.go/history on tab click.

shortcuts.action: open/close command palette, search and navigation
collapse top navigation on desktop / open mobile navigation control
dashboard, actionCenter, files, clients, cases, hearings, procedures, search, reports
Work Center: new task/today/week/month/refresh outside inputs
focus current DataGrid search outside inputs
close topmost overlay/menu/mobile nav according to overlay stack
move rows/open focused record; header arrows resize columns and sorting has modifier shortcuts

migrations.title: الملاحظات السريعة: توسيع caseNotes وإضافة روابط ومسودات محلية
FEAS: تعريف الالتزامات وفترات الاعتراف الصريحة + مفاتيح منع التكرار
المزامنة ثنائية الاتجاه: سجل تغييرات تفاضلي، حالة الأجهزة، والتعارضات مع Tombstones
قسم التنفيذ: الشرائح والحركات المالية والتخصيصات والمحاضر والتوكيلات والفروق والتسويات والإجراءات
مركز العمل: عناصر العمل والتعليقات وتعريفات التكرار

data.migrationPolicy: SCHEMA_MIGRATIONS declare additive upgrades; W0 made no schema/database edits. Version 18 adds quickNoteLinks and caseNoteDrafts plus indexes; no destructive change/backfill is declared.

persistence.mode: offline-first local IndexedDB; core application requires no backend

preferences.note: UI preferences are separate from office record databases; reuse this API/store rather than adding a navigation-specific source of truth.

routeAndActionArchitecture.router: PAGES/recordRoute in js/app.js; App.go is the current page transition entry point
routeAndActionArchitecture.genericLists: LIST_STORES → js/modules/list-page.js; common entity form is js/ui/form.js; DataGrid is js/ui/datagrid.js; validation/write/business rules in js/services/* + Office/Repository
routeAndActionArchitecture.records: client/file/case/opponent plus rec:<store>:<id>; relationship IDs remain in relationship stores/services
routeAndActionArchitecture.quickAdd: global + Add, context actions and command palette reuse js/modules/quick-add.js; Ctrl+Shift+N is Quick Notes capture

features.home: js/modules/home.js — Office Today, Focus/next-step, tasks, visit state, Quick Add
features.files: js/modules/list-page.js + client-file.js + file-page.js — generic file list and 15-section File Cockpit
features.workCenter: js/modules/work-center.js + js/services/work-* + js/ui/work-* — 10 ranges/12 views, scoped overlays, linked data and saved views
features.settings: js/modules/settings.js — appearance, taxonomy, lookups, display/collapse/component styling and maintenance
features.execution: js/modules/execution-center.js + execution services — execution queue/list and 4 detail tabs
features.search: js/modules/search.js + js/services/search-engine.js — global search and saved/history state
features.dataGrid: js/ui/datagrid.js + js/ui/pagination.js — indexed/cursor pagination and per-grid filters/views/columns/selection/export/print
